summary.text: Retail traders experienced one of the most devastating single-day losses in recent memory, with portfolio destruction reaching historic proportions across multiple sectors and timeframes.
Put option holders captured extraordinary profits as major indices collapsed, with some zero-day trades delivering over ten times returns in minutes during the market rout.
The semiconductor sector led the decline amid earnings concerns and broader AI infrastructure questions, while SpaceX IPO speculation adds complexity to an already volatile environment.
